Hero_Desc_Naia:
Life-of-the-party elemental who brightens the mood around her with a bit of playfulness.
You can say that she is Miss Popular in Elias.
Her slight lack of seriousness can sometimes make those around her a bit flustered though.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_Naia: I'm the Life of the Party
Album_Like_Naia: Playing with water. Food made with seaweed.
Album_Hate_Naia: Biting sarcasm and dark humor. The strange debris drifting in from the elven city.
Album_Wish_Naia: Giving every creature on the surface gills so they can play with her.
Album_Naia1: Naia is a daredevil of a water elemental. With the most open, and brightest, personality, she calls herself the 'coolest elemental.' Well... she's not wrong.
Album_Naia2: Naia once sneaked into Ashur's Bakery, stuffing the pies with fish before running away. After baking these so-called fish pies, Ashur unintentionally became even more famous.
Album_Naia3: When asked if she gets along with the phantoms, who are also known for pulling pranks, Naia admitted their pranks don't really make her laugh. She insisted that her pranks do not cross the line, while I was on the verge of drowning.
Album_Naia4: Naia despises the trash piling up around the lake. She regularly cleans up around there with other water elementals. It seems most of the debris has washed up from the elven city.
Album_Naia5: It doesn't seem as if the elves intentionally polluted the lake. In the past, Mayor Elena offered to install a trash filter dam on the lake, as a way to apologize. But it was said that Naia refused, not wanting to mar the lake's beauty.
Album_Naia6: I once was ordered to voluntarily help Naia clean the lake. I gave it my all; it was tough but rewarding. The trash, it seemed, mostly come from sprite packaging, like plastic wrappers from baked goods... and not from the elves.
Album_Naia7: Naia sometimes sees strange hallucinations while cleaning. She believes something unknown lurks in the abyss of the lake. Even she doesn't dare approach the deepest waters. "If you get too close, something might awaken." Her eerie words sent a chill down my spine.

Food_ChefNote_Naia_Like8: After taking a bite, Naia marveled at the food's magical melting quality. She joked that if we made a lake out of it, the Werebeasts would love it. I had a hard time dissuading her from the idea.

LoveCall_Naia:
Hmm, is this how I call?
Ah! Master! Hello, hello~ Guess who called~? Pew-pew~!
It is none other than~ Naia~!

I almost fought with Ifrit again today. She kept teasing me!
I was about to lose my temper like usual, but suddenly remembered you scolding me and held it in!
